toolPage.inAppText: This tool is one of 20 in ConvCalc, alongside a scientific calculator with history. The app is free and has no ads.

currency.label: Currency
currency.title: Currency converter: free exchange rate calculator
currency.description: Convert US dollars, euros, pounds, yen and other currencies at a recent exchange rate, for free. Also available in the ConvCalc iPhone app.
currency.intro: Type an amount in one currency and see it in the others at once.
currency.how: Tap a currency to make it the one you're typing in. The rates on this page are refreshed daily and are for reference only, because banks and card issuers usually add a margin. The ConvCalc app lets you choose your own list of currencies.

length.label: Length
length.title: Length converter: mm, cm, meters, km, inches, feet, yards, miles
length.description: Convert between millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. See every unit at once, for free.
length.intro: See millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles together as you type.
length.how: Tap a unit, then type your value. Every other unit updates immediately, so you don't need to choose a target unit first. It works for anything from a screw size to a road trip.

area.label: Area
area.title: Area converter: square meters, square feet, acres, hectares
area.description: Convert between square meters, square feet, square kilometers, square miles, acres and hectares, for free.
area.intro: Convert square meters, square feet, square kilometers, square miles, acres and hectares in one place.
area.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. It's useful for comparing apartment listings, land plots and floor plans that use different units.

mass.label: Mass
mass.title: Weight and mass converter: kg, lbs, ounces, grams, stone, tons
mass.description: Convert between kilograms, pounds, ounces, grams, stone, tons and more. See every unit at once, for free.
mass.intro: Convert milligrams, grams, kilograms, ounces, pounds, stone and tons, along with less common units such as drams and slugs.
mass.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see all the others. It covers kitchen scales, body weight, luggage limits and freight. The tons are listed separately as short, long and metric, because they aren't the same.

volume.label: Volume
volume.title: Volume converter: liters, gallons, cups, quarts, pints, ml
volume.description: Convert between milliliters, liters, US gallons, quarts, pints, cups and fluid ounces, for free.
volume.intro: Convert milliliters, liters, gallons, quarts, pints, cups and fluid ounces as you type.
volume.how: Tap a unit and type your value. The gallon, quart, pint, cup and fluid ounce are US measures, so results for British recipes will be different.

speed.label: Speed
speed.title: Speed converter: km/h, mph, knots, m/s
speed.description: Convert between kilometers per hour, miles per hour, knots and meters per second, for free.
speed.intro: Switch between kilometers per hour, miles per hour, knots and meters per second.
speed.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. It's handy for road signs abroad, wind forecasts and sailing or flying.

pressure.label: Pressure
pressure.title: Pressure converter: PSI, bar, kPa, atm, inHg, torr
pressure.description: Convert between pascals, kilopascals, bar, atmospheres, PSI, inches of mercury and torr, for free.
pressure.intro: Convert pascals, kilopascals, bar, atmospheres, PSI, inches of mercury and torr.
pressure.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. It's useful for tire pressure, weather readings and workshop gauges.

power.label: Power
power.title: Power converter: watts, kilowatts, horsepower, BTU per minute
power.description: Convert between watts, kilowatts, horsepower and BTU per minute, for free.
power.intro: Convert watts, kilowatts, horsepower and BTU per minute.
power.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. It's useful for comparing engines, motors and heating or cooling equipment.

temperature.label: Temp
temperature.title: Temperature converter: temp conversion for °C, °F and K
temperature.description: Convert between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin instantly, for free.
temperature.intro: Convert Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin as you type.
temperature.how: Tap a scale and type your value to see the others. Use it for weather, oven settings and lab work.

angle.label: Angle
angle.title: Angle converter: degrees, radians, arcminutes, arcseconds
angle.description: Convert between degrees, radians, arcminutes, arcseconds and smaller angle units, for free.
angle.intro: Convert degrees, radians, milliradians, arcminutes, arcseconds and smaller units.
angle.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. It's useful for trigonometry homework, optics and astronomy.

energy.label: Energy
energy.title: Energy converter: joules, calories, kWh, BTU
energy.description: Convert between joules, kilojoules, calories, kilocalories, BTU, kilowatt-hours and more, for free.
energy.intro: Convert joules, kilojoules, calories, kilocalories, BTU, kilowatt-hours, ergs and foot-pounds.
energy.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. It's useful for food labels, electricity bills and physics problems.

force.label: Force
force.title: Force converter: newtons, kilogram-force, pound-force
force.description: Convert between newtons, kilogram-force, pound-force, poundals and dynes, for free.
force.intro: Convert newtons, kilogram-force, pound-force, poundals and dynes.
force.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. It's useful for engineering specifications and physics problems.

fuel.label: Fuel
fuel.title: Fuel economy converter: mpg, L/100km, km/L
fuel.description: Convert fuel economy between miles per gallon, liters per 100 km, kilometers per liter and gallons per 100 miles, for free.
fuel.intro: Convert miles per gallon, liters per 100 km, kilometers per liter and gallons per 100 miles.
fuel.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. For liters per 100 km and gallons per 100 miles, a lower number means better economy. The gallon here is the US gallon.

time.label: Time
time.title: Time converter: seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, years
time.description: Convert between milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks and years, for free.
time.intro: Convert milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks and years.
time.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. A year is counted as the average 365.25 days.

data.label: Data
data.title: Data size converter: bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB, PB
data.description: Convert between bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes, terabytes and petabytes, for free.
data.intro: Convert bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes, terabytes and petabytes.
data.how: Tap a unit and type your value to see the others. Each step is 1,024 of the one below it, which is the way operating systems often count file sizes. Storage makers often use 1,000 instead.

age.label: Age
age.title: Age calculator: find your exact age from your date of birth
age.description: Calculate your age from a date of birth, in exact years, months and days. Free, with no sign-up.
age.intro: Enter a date of birth and see the exact age in years, months and days.
age.how: Tap year, month or day and type the value. The result uses today's date on your device.

bmi.label: BMI
bmi.title: BMI calculator: body mass index from height and weight
bmi.description: Enter your height in centimeters and weight in kilograms to see your body mass index and its standard category. Free.
bmi.intro: Enter your height and weight to see your body mass index and its standard category.
bmi.how: BMI is your weight in kilograms divided by your height in meters, squared. The categories are underweight below 18.5, normal up to 25, overweight up to 30 and obese above that. BMI is a rough screening measure and doesn't replace medical advice.

date.label: Date
date.title: Date calculator: days between two dates
date.description: A days calculator and day counter: find the days, weeks, months and years between dates. Free, with no sign-up.
date.intro: Enter two dates to see the days between dates, plus the difference in weeks, months and years.
date.how: Tap a field and type the value. Months and years in the result are averages, 30.4375 and 365.25 days long, so they appear as decimals.

discount.label: Discount
discount.title: Discount calculator: percent off and sale price
discount.description: Enter a price and a percentage to see how much you save and what you'll pay. Free percent off calculator.
discount.intro: Enter a price and a percentage to see how much you save and the final price.
discount.how: The saving is the price multiplied by the percentage, divided by 100. Subtract the saving from the price to get what you'll pay. Sales tax isn't included.

loan.label: Loan
loan.title: Loan calculator: monthly payment and total interest
loan.description: Enter a loan amount, annual interest rate and term to see the monthly payment, total paid and total interest. Free.
loan.intro: Enter the amount, annual rate and number of years to see the monthly payment, total paid and total interest.
loan.how: It assumes a fixed rate and equal monthly payments, without fees or insurance. Treat the result as an estimate and check the final terms with your lender.

scientific-calculator.label: Scientific calculator
scientific-calculator.title: Free scientific calculator app for iPhone
scientific-calculator.description: A free scientific calculator for iPhone with trig, inverse and hyperbolic functions, logs, powers, factorials and constants. No ads.
scientific-calculator.h1: A scientific calculator that doesn't look like one
scientific-calculator.intro: Most of the time you just need to add things up, so ConvCalc starts simple. One tap on the corner key opens the full scientific keypad.

sections.title: All the functions you'd expect
sections.text: Sine, cosine and tangent, with inverse and hyperbolic versions. Natural and base 10 logs, powers, square roots, factorials, reciprocals, pi, e and a random number key.

sections.title: Degrees or radians
sections.text: Switch angle mode with one key. The display shows the whole expression and a live result, so you can catch a mistake before pressing equals.

sections.title: Fix it without starting over
sections.text: Delete the last thing you typed, or go back to a previous calculation in your history and carry on from there.

calculator-with-history.label: Calculator with history
calculator-with-history.title: Calculator app with history for iPhone
calculator-with-history.description: A free iPhone calculator that saves every calculation. Open your history, tap a past result and keep going. No ads.
calculator-with-history.intro: ConvCalc saves each calculation you finish, so that number from ten minutes ago is still there when you need it.

sections.title: Your past calculations, one tap away
sections.text: Tap the clock in the top corner to see each expression and its result.

sections.title: Reuse any result
sections.text: Tap a past calculation to bring it back and keep calculating from it.

sections.title: Clear it when you like
sections.text: History is stored on your iPhone, and you can clear it at any time.

compareHub.lede: We make ConvCalc, so read these with that in mind. Prices and ratings come from the App Store and are dated, and our opinions are labeled as opinions.

comparePage.disclosure: We make ConvCalc, so weigh our pick accordingly.
comparePage.dataNote: Download prices and US App Store ratings as of {date}. In-app purchases aren't shown, so check each listing for what's included.
comparePage.whyText: This part is our opinion: most calculators are either plain or crowded. ConvCalc puts everything behind clean, tactile keys, with a scientific keypad that opens with one tap, a history you can reuse, and 20 tools for units, currency and everyday math. It's also young, with only a handful of App Store ratings so far, so it hasn't earned the track record of some apps on this list.

convcalc-vs-apple-calculator.label: ConvCalc vs Apple Calculator
convcalc-vs-apple-calculator.title: ConvCalc vs Apple Calculator: which should you use on iPhone?
convcalc-vs-apple-calculator.description: An honest comparison of ConvCalc and the Calculator app built into iOS, from the people who make ConvCalc.
convcalc-vs-apple-calculator.intro: Apple's Calculator has improved a lot, and it's already on your phone. Here's when ConvCalc is worth adding.

takes.convcalc: Our pick for design. Scientific keys, reusable history, currency and 19 more tools, with no ads.
takes.apple: Comes with iOS. Since iOS 18 it includes a history, unit conversion and Math Notes, so it's a good place to start.
takes.pcalc: The power user's choice. Its listing includes optional RPN, a paper tape, multiple button layouts, hex, octal and binary, and an Apple Watch app.
takes.pcalclite: A free version of PCalc with optional RPN, undo and redo, and unit conversions. The listing reserves the paper tape and some themes for the full app.
takes.calcbot: A long-running calculator from Tapbots. Its listing includes a history tape, an expression view, scientific functions, and unit and currency conversion.
takes.calculatorplus: The most rated app here. Its listing covers scientific, history, unit and currency tools, and advertises a premium tier that's free of full-screen ads.
takes.tydlig: A different idea: a freeform canvas with linked numbers and live results, plus graphing. Its last App Store update was in 2017.
takes.calchistory: A simple option whose listing promises no ads, with history, optional scientific functions and customizable keyboard colors and sounds.
takes.desmos: A free, focused scientific calculator from Desmos, with trigonometry, statistics, combinatorics and your own functions.
takes.convcalcSci: Our pick for everyday scientific use. Trig, inverse and hyperbolic functions, logs and factorials behind a keypad you can hide, with no ads.
takes.appleSci: Built into iOS, with a scientific mode and history. Worth trying before you download anything.

rows: 14 categories, every unit shown at once

versus.verdict: If you want math notes or use an iPad, stay with Apple's app. If you want everyday tools like loan, age and date calculators in one place, or you prefer how ConvCalc looks, it's worth the free download. Plenty of people could keep both.
